encoding: the build host serves the text assets (index.html, JS/CSS chunks, embed.css) brotli-compressed (content-encoding: br). The capture stores the content-decoded bytes exactly as a browser receives them, so a naive static server serves the mirror correctly as identity; derive/audit inflate in memory only (never write re-encoded variants)

closure method: runtime network log of a full browser session (page load, main menu, intro/garage asset set, a complete 3-lap race and the finish screen — docs/network-log-2026-10-13.jsonl) + the game's embedded tables (five-circuit table vJ, scenery->kit map, music library table, ship table Xu, lunar/award textures in the intro set) — union probed to fixpoint; nothing referenced is missing
